info.name: EMS Backend API Collection
info.description:
Complete API Collection for Employee Management System (EMS) Backend built with Django REST Framework.

### Authentication
This collection uses JWT Bearer Token authentication. 
1. Register a user or Login with existing credentials.
2. The **Login** request automatically sets the `access_token` and `refresh_token` environment variables.
3. Requests in the **Company Management** folder inherit Bearer Token authentication (except **Get All Companies**, which is a public endpoint with no auth requirement).

item.name: User Management & Auth
item.description: Endpoints for User Registration, Login, JWT Token Refresh, User Listing, User Detail, Update, Soft Delete (Deactivation), and Restore.

request.description: Registers a new user account in the system (company ID and role ID are optional for superusers).

exec: console.log('Access and Refresh tokens updated in environment.');

request.description: Authenticates user with username or email and returns JWT access & refresh tokens.
Generates a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Creates a new user account via administrative endpoint. Requires JWT Bearer Token authorization.

query.description: Filter by username, email, first_name, or last_name
Page number for paginated results (5 users per page)

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of registered users with optional search, company, role, status, active status, and page filters. Returns 5 users per page. Requires JWT Bearer Token authorization.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific user by ID.
Performs a complete update of a user record by ID.
Performs a partial update of specific user fields by ID.
Soft deletes (deactivates) a user by setting is_active=false without permanently deleting the record from the database.
Restores a soft-deleted user by setting is_active=true without changing the user record.

query.description: Filter by username, email, first_name, or last_name
Page number for paginated results (5 users per page)

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of pending users belonging to the logged in user's company.
Approves a pending user account by updating status to approved.
Rejects a user account by updating status to rejected.

item.name: Role Management
item.description: Endpoints to Manage Roles (CRUD operations). Requires JWT Authorization.

query.description: Filter by role name or description (case-insensitive)

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of roles with optional search, company, page, and page_size filters. Public endpoint (No authentication required).

exec: console.log('Created role_id saved to environment:', response.data.id);

request.description: Creates a new role record. The 'code' field is auto-generated from 'name' (converted to upper snake_case, e.g., 'SENIOR_DEVELOPER'). 'company' is optional for system roles.
Creates a new system-wide role record without assigning a specific company.
Retrieves the full details of a specific role by ID.
Performs a full update of an existing role record.
Performs a partial update of specific fields of an existing role record.
Deletes a role record by ID.

query.description: Filter by role name, permission name, resource, or action

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of role permissions with optional search, role, permission, page, and page_size filters.

exec: console.log('Created role_permission_id saved to environment:', response.data.id);

request.description: Assigns a permission to a role.
Retrieves details of a specific role permission assignment by ID.
Performs a full update of a role permission assignment.
Performs a partial update of a role permission assignment.
Deletes a role permission assignment by ID.

item.name: Permission Management
item.description: Endpoints to Manage Permissions (CRUD operations). Requires JWT Authorization.

query.description: Filter by permission name, resource, action, or description
Filter by resource name (e.g., project, company)
Filter by action (e.g., create, read, update, delete)

request.description: Retrieves a paginated list of permissions with optional search, resource, action, page, and page_size filters.

exec: console.log('Created permission_id saved to environment:', response.data.id);

request.description: Creates a new permission record with explicit name, resource, action, and description.
Creates a new permission record omitting 'name', which auto-generates as 'resource.action' (e.g., 'department.update').
Retrieves the full details of a specific permission by ID.
Performs a full update of an existing permission record.
Performs a partial update of specific fields of an existing permission record.
Deletes a permission record by ID.
